title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented NAU rituals, symbols, and recurring campus practices centered on Lumberjack spirit and Homecoming.

cards.title: Sprint into the first home game
cards.subtitle: First NAU home football game
cards.notes: If you are a first-year student, join the designated field run just before the football team enters to begin the season.
cards.short_summary: A first-year field sprint launches the football season.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU describes Running of the Freshmen as first-year students sprinting across the field at the first home football game.
cards.access_notes: For first-year students; follow event and stadium staff instructions.

cards.title: Come back for Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Flagstaff campus and downtown parade route
cards.notes: Check the annual schedule, then choose a public Homecoming event such as the parade or football game to take part in campus pride.
cards.short_summary: A week-long NAU reunion tradition dating to 1924.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU states that Homecoming has been a Lumberjack-pride staple since 1924 and is a week-long celebration.
cards.access_notes: Event details vary annually; consult NAU’s current Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Listen for the touchdown tree cookie
cards.subtitle: NAU football field
cards.notes: At a football game, watch the field after a Lumberjack touchdown for the Logging Sports Club’s ceremonial log slice.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU says a tree-cookie slice is cut on the field to celebrate touchdowns, with the Logging Sports Club involved.
cards.access_notes: Observe from spectator areas and follow stadium instructions.

cards.title: Throw the L-J
cards.subtitle: NAU games, photos, and campus events
cards.notes: Make an L with your right hand and a J with your left when joining a photo or showing Lumberjack pride.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU identifies the L-J hand sign as part of Lumberjack culture and gives the right-hand L, left-hand J formation.
cards.access_notes: Appropriate for public photos and sporting events.

cards.title: Join the fight-song chorus
cards.subtitle: Game days and Homecoming
cards.notes: Learn the NAU fight song before a game, then sing along with the crowd when the song is played or led.
cards.short_summary: A blue-and-gold rally song for Lumberjack events.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU calls its fight song a rally cry that brings Lumberjacks together on game day and every day.
cards.access_notes: Follow event leaders and stadium guidance.

cards.title: Help spell N-A-U
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week, South Fields
cards.notes: During Welcome Week, wear the provided letters shirt and join the arranged group photo that spells N-A-U from the field.
cards.short_summary: New students form giant NAU letters for a photo.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU lists the NAU Letters Photo as a Welcome Week event where participants spell N-A-U at the South Fields.
cards.source_title: NAU Welcome Week | Discover your community at NAU
cards.access_notes: Scheduled during Welcome Week; verify the current event calendar.

cards.title: Launch your Lumberjack chapter
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week, Walkup Skydome
cards.notes: Attend the Welcome Week celebration in the Skydome to mark your entry into the Lumberjack family with other new students.
cards.short_summary: A Skydome welcome celebration for new Lumberjacks.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU describes Lumberjack Launch as a Skydome celebration of students’ entry into the Lumberjack family.
cards.source_title: NAU Welcome Week | Discover your community at NAU
cards.access_notes: Scheduled during Welcome Week; verify the current event calendar.

cards.title: Spot the Dedicatee tap
cards.subtitle: NAU Homecoming
cards.notes: At Homecoming, watch for the Chain Gang’s ceremonial tap of the selected dedicatee and read the event program for context.
cards.short_summary: Chain Gang members ceremonially tap NAU’s Homecoming dedicatee.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU documents a Chain Gang custom, dating to 1936, of tapping the Homecoming dedicatee.
cards.source_title: The importance of traditions | The NAU Review
cards.access_notes: Observe as part of the official Homecoming program.

cards.title: Watch the Chain Gang’s big chop
cards.subtitle: NAU football game
cards.notes: Look for Chain Gang members and the axe at a football game; the big chop is used to usher in the team.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU reports that Chain Gang members wield the Chain Gang axe for the “big chop” that ushers in the football team.
cards.source_title: The importance of traditions | The NAU Review
cards.access_notes: Observe from spectator areas; only designated participants handle ceremonial equipment.

cards.title: Find the historic logging wheels
cards.subtitle: NAU Homecoming parade, downtown Flagstaff
cards.notes: Choose a safe public viewing spot along the parade route and look for the historic logging wheels in the Homecoming procession.
cards.short_summary: Historic logging wheels anchor NAU’s annual parade.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU identifies the historic logging wheels as the centerpiece of the annual Homecoming parade since 1932.
cards.source_title: The importance of traditions | The NAU Review
cards.access_notes: Use public parade viewing areas and follow local event controls.
